title: Gravel Storm
caption: Gravel Storm (V)
game_text: Lose 1 Force to target a desert or non-interior Tatooine site. For remainder of turn, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.
lore: Tatooine’s twin suns cause turbulent storms that strike with little or no warning. Strong winds whip rocks through the air with enormous force.

notes: Sheet group: Everything else (Dark Side). Non-unique. Printed card is a Lost Interrupt; slip banner USED INTERRUPT. Credits below the text box: left 'Original concept by Brian Hollingworth', right 'Betashyyykshire V-Lite 2005' (three y's, as printed). Slip text matches the stub. Printed text was 'Strikes at Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, … Target lost if destiny > ability.' Wiki 'Gravel Storm' page = printed archive face (PC Errata page separate). Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in Tatooine’s (wiki straight). COPYRIGHT: the printed card's vertical line reads 'TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC. THIS CARD ROCKS.' (Decipher's easter egg) — legible on both the 350 archive scan and the 745 face; kept in full. The 745 px Premiere-D-gravelstorm.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face: 'opponent’s character present at that site') — downloaded to src/vs15/48-Premiere-D-gravelstorm.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src.
